name: Yavra
found: Main Jetty at Caelrun, waiting at night for a passenger.
appearance: Amazigh, wiry, wet to the knees.
and_yet: Suspicious eyes in a smiling face.
wants: Passengers who pay well and don't talk.
dreams: To retire rich to Imazuran and never explain how.
family: Married into the Norvaks of Caelrun, but works alone and sends money home.
dm_notes: Her night trips run Imazuran wine past the Caelrun tariff.
